English (source): Not a medical device. Does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition.
Français: Ceci n'est pas un dispositif médical. L'application ne diagnostique, ne traite, ne guérit ni ne prévient aucune maladie.
Lingala – draft: Oyo ezali esaleli ya monganga te. Eyebisaka bokono te, esalisaka te, ebikisaka te mpe epekisaka bokono te.
Kikongo – draft: Yai kele ve kima ya munganga. Yo ke zabisaka ve maladi, ke belusaka ve, ke kangaka ve maladi.
Tshiluba – draft: Eci kí tshintu tshia munganga to. Katshiena tshimanya disama, tshiondapa, tshiondopa anyi tshipangisha disama to.
Kiswahili: Hiki si kifaa cha matibabu. Hakigundui, hakitibu, hakiponyi wala hakizuii ugonjwa wowote.

English (source): Fever + possible exposure? Isolate and call for help.
Français: Fièvre + contact possible ? Isolez-vous et appelez à l’aide.
Lingala – draft: Fièvre + okoki kozala okutani na Ebola? Kabwana na bato mpe benga mpo na lisalisi.
Kikongo – draft: Fièvre + nge me kutana ntama ya Ebola? Kabuka na bantu mpi binga sambu na lusadisu.
Tshiluba – draft: Fièvre + udi mupetangane ne Ebola? Dikosa ku bantu ne bikila bua kuambuluishibua.
Kiswahili: Homa + uwezekano wa kuambukizwa? Jitenge na upige simu kuomba msaada.

English (source): This translation is new and is being checked. If something is unclear, use French or English.
Français: Cette traduction est nouvelle et en cours de vérification. Si quelque chose n'est pas clair, utilisez le français ou l'anglais.
Lingala – draft: Libongoli oyo ezali ya sika mpe bazali kotala yango. Soki eloko moko ekomi polele te, salela Lifalanse to Lingelesi.
Kikongo – draft: Ndinga yai kele ya mpa, bantu ke tala yo. Kana kima mosi ke ya pwelele ve, sadila Fwalansa to Angele.
Tshiluba – draft: Dikudimuna edi ndipiadipia, bantu badi badikonkonona. Biwikala kuyi umvua bimpe, enza mudimu ne Mfualansa anyi Angele.
Kiswahili: Tafsiri hii ni mpya na inakaguliwa. Ikiwa kitu hakieleweki, tumia Kifaransa au Kiingereza.

English (source): Could not open the dialer. Please call {n}.
Français: Impossible d'ouvrir le téléphone. Appelez le {n}.
Kikongo – draft: Beto me kuka ve kukangula telefone. Binga {n}.
Tshiluba – draft: Katuena mua kubulula telefone to. Bikila {n}.

English (source): This app is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition. Only a laboratory test can confirm Ebola.
Français: Cette application n'est pas un dispositif médical et ne diagnostique, ne traite, ne guérit ni ne prévient aucune maladie. Seul un test de laboratoire peut confirmer Ebola.
Lingala – draft: Application oyo ezali esaleli ya monganga te. Eyebisaka te soki ozali na bokono, ebikisaka te mpe epekisaka bokono te. Kaka kotala makila na laboratoire nde ekoki koyebisa soki Ebola ezali.
Kikongo – draft: Application yai kele ve kima ya munganga. Yo ke zabisaka ve maladi, ke belusaka ve, ke kangaka ve maladi. Kaka laboratoire lenda kuzabisa kana Ebola kele.
Tshiluba – draft: Application eyi kí tshintu tshia munganga to. Kayena imanya disama, ondapa, ondopa anyi pangisha disama to. Anu laboratoire ke udi mua kumanya ne Ebola udiku.
Kiswahili: Programu hii si kifaa cha matibabu na haigundui, haitibu, haiponyi wala haizuii ugonjwa wowote. Ni kipimo cha maabara pekee kinachoweza kuthibitisha Ebola.

English (source): The check and the AI assistant give general health information based on public-health guidance. The AI can make mistakes.
Français: Le questionnaire et l'assistant IA donnent des informations générales basées sur les recommandations de santé publique. L'IA peut se tromper.
Lingala – draft: Mituna mpe mosalisi ya IA bapesaka toli ya kolanda na bokolongono, ndenge bakonzi ya santé balakisaka. IA ekoki kosala libunga.
Kikongo – draft: Bangyufula mpi musadisi ya IA ke pesaka malongi ya santé ya mbandu, na kulanda bantu ya santé ya leta. IA lenda kusala foti.
Tshiluba – draft: Nkonko ne muambuluishi wa IA badi bafila mibelu ya bukole bua mubidi bilondeshile bamfumu ba santé. IA udi mua kupambuka.
Kiswahili: Uchunguzi na msaidizi wa AI hutoa taarifa za jumla za afya kulingana na miongozo ya afya ya umma. AI inaweza kukosea.

English (source): If you have a fever or other symptoms AND may have been exposed, separate yourself from others and call your health hotline or emergency number immediately.
Français: Si vous avez de la fièvre ou d'autres symptômes ET que vous avez peut-être été exposé, éloignez-vous des autres et appelez immédiatement la ligne d'urgence sanitaire.
Lingala – draft: Soki ozali na fièvre to bilembo mosusu MPE okoki kozala okutani na Ebola, kabwana na bato mosusu mpe benga mbala moko numero ya mbangu ya santé.
Kikongo – draft: Kana nge kele ti fièvre to bidimbu yankaka MPI nge lenda vanda me kutana ti Ebola, kabuka na bantu yankaka mpi binga nswalu numero ya santé.
Tshiluba – draft: Biwikala ne fièvre anyi bimanyinu bikuabu NE biwikala mua kupetangana ne Ebola, dikosa ku bantu bakuabu ne bikila diakamue numero wa santé.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa una homa au dalili nyingine NA huenda uliambukizwa, jitenge na wengine na upige simu mara moja kwa namba ya dharura ya afya.

English (source): Messages you send to the assistant are processed by our server and an AI provider. Do not enter your name, address or other identifying details.
Français: Les messages envoyés à l'assistant sont traités par notre serveur et un fournisseur d'IA. N'écrivez pas votre nom, votre adresse ou d'autres informations personnelles.
Lingala – draft: Bansango otindeli mosalisi ezali kosalema na serveur na biso mpe na moto ya IA. Kokoma kombo na yo, adrési to makambo mosusu ya bomoi na yo te.
Kikongo – draft: Bansangu nge ke tindila musadisi ke salamaka na serveur na beto mpi na ntwadisi ya IA. Sonika ve zina na nge, adrési to mambu yankaka ya luzingu na nge.
Tshiluba – draft: Mikanda iutumina muambuluishi idi ienzeka kudi serveur wetu ne kudi muena IA. Kufundi dîna diebe, adrési anyi malu makuabu a muoyo webe to.
Kiswahili: Ujumbe unaomtumia msaidizi huchakatwa na seva yetu na mtoa huduma wa AI. Usiandike jina lako, anwani au taarifa nyingine za kukutambulisha.

Lingala – draft: Tanga mibeko ya kobatela makambo na yo
Kikongo – draft: Tanga mibeko ya kukeba mambu na nge
Tshiluba – draft: Bala mikenji ya kulama malu ebe

Lingala – draft: Ozali komiyoka malamu te to ozali na mitungisi?
Kikongo – draft: Nge ke kudiwa mbote ve to nge kele ti boma?
Tshiluba – draft: Udi udiumvua bibi anyi udi ne bualu?

English (source): Answer a few questions about symptoms and possible contact. Get clear next steps in 2 minutes.
Français: Répondez à quelques questions sur vos symptômes et les contacts possibles. Obtenez des conseils clairs en 2 minutes.
Lingala – draft: Yanola mituna mike na ntina ya bilembo mpe soki okutanaki na moto. Zwa toli ya polele na miniti 2.
Kikongo – draft: Vutula bangyufula fioti sambu na bidimbu mpi kana nge me kutana ti muntu. Baka malongi ya pwelele na baminiti 2.
Tshiluba – draft: Andamuna ku nkonko mikese ya bimanyinu ne bua kupetangana ne muntu. Angata mibelu mimvuike mu miniti 2.
Kiswahili: Jibu maswali machache kuhusu dalili na uwezekano wa kuambukizwa. Pata hatua zilizo wazi kwa dakika 2.

English (source): Fever + possible contact? Isolate and call.
Français: Fièvre + contact possible ? Isolez-vous et appelez.
Lingala – draft: Fièvre + okoki kozala okutani na Ebola? Kabwana mpe benga.
Kikongo – draft: Fièvre + nge me kutana ti Ebola? Kabuka mpi binga.
Tshiluba – draft: Fièvre + udi mupetangane ne Ebola? Dikosa ne bikila.
Kiswahili: Homa + uwezekano wa kuambukizwa? Jitenge na upige simu.

English (source): If someone has a fever or other symptoms after possible contact, keep them apart from others and call now.
Français: Si une personne a de la fièvre ou d'autres symptômes après un contact possible, éloignez-la des autres et appelez maintenant.
Lingala – draft: Soki moto azali na fièvre to bilembo mosusu nsima ya kokutana na moto ya Ebola, kabola ye na bato mosusu mpe benga sikoyo.
Kikongo – draft: Kana muntu kele ti fièvre to bidimbu yankaka na nima ya kukutana ti muntu ya Ebola, kabula yandi na bantu yankaka mpi binga ntangu yai.
Tshiluba – draft: Muntu biikala ne fièvre anyi bimanyinu bikuabu panyima pa kupetangana ne muntu wa Ebola, mutapulula ne bantu bakuabu ne bikila katataka.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtu ana homa au dalili nyingine baada ya uwezekano wa kuambukizwa, mtenge na wengine na upige simu sasa.

English (source): Ebola does not spread through the air. It spreads through contact with blood and body fluids of a sick person.
Français: Ebola ne se transmet pas par l'air. Il se transmet par contact avec le sang et les liquides du corps d'une personne malade.
Lingala – draft: Ebola ekendaka na mopepe te. Ekendaka soki osimbi makila to mai ya nzoto ya moto ya maladi.
Kikongo – draft: Ebola ke kwendaka ve na mupepe. Yo ke kwendaka kana nge me simba menga to mayi ya nitu ya muntu ya maladi.
Tshiluba – draft: Ebola kena uya ne lupepele to. Udi uya paudi ulenga mashi anyi mâyi a mubidi a muntu musama.
Kiswahili: Ebola haienezwi kwa hewa. Huenezwa kwa kugusa damu na majimaji ya mwili ya mgonjwa.

English (source): People with Ebola are not contagious before symptoms start.
Français: Les personnes atteintes d'Ebola ne sont pas contagieuses avant le début des symptômes.
Lingala – draft: Moto ya Ebola apesaka bokono te liboso bilembo ebanda.
Kikongo – draft: Muntu ya Ebola ke pesaka ve maladi ntete ya bidimbu kubanda.
Tshiluba – draft: Muntu wa Ebola kena ukuatshisha bakuabu disama kumpala kua bimanyinu kutuadija to.
Kiswahili: Watu wenye Ebola hawaambukizi kabla ya dalili kuanza.

English (source): Symptoms can appear from 2 to 21 days after exposure.
Français: Les symptômes peuvent apparaître de 2 à 21 jours après l'exposition.
Lingala – draft: Bilembo ekoki kobima nsima ya mikolo 2 kino 21 nsima ya kokutana na bokono.
Kikongo – draft: Bidimbu lenda basika na bilumbu 2 tii 21 na nima ya kukutana ti maladi.
Tshiluba – draft: Bimanyinu bidi mua kumueneka panyima pa matuku 2 too ne 21 panyima pa kupetangana ne disama.
Kiswahili: Dalili zinaweza kuonekana siku 2 hadi 21 baada ya kuambukizwa.

English (source): Early treatment at an Ebola treatment centre saves lives.
Français: Un traitement précoce dans un centre de traitement Ebola sauve des vies.
Lingala – draft: Kosalisama noki na centre ya kosalisa Ebola ebikisaka bomoi.
Kikongo – draft: Kubelusa nswalu na centre ya Ebola ke gulusaka luzingu.
Tshiluba – draft: Kuondapibua lukasa ku centre wa Ebola kudi kupandisha muoyo.
Kiswahili: Matibabu ya mapema katika kituo cha matibabu ya Ebola huokoa maisha.

English (source): Washing hands with soap and water is one of the best ways to protect your family.
Français: Se laver les mains avec de l'eau et du savon est l'un des meilleurs moyens de protéger votre famille.
Lingala – draft: Kosukola maboko na mai mpe sabuni ezali lolenge moko ya malamu ya kobatela libota na yo.
Kikongo – draft: Kusukula maboko na mayi mpi savuni kele mpila mosi ya mbote ya kukeba dibuta na nge.
Tshiluba – draft: Kuowa bianza ne mâyi ne disabu nkimue tshia ku malu mimpe a kulama dîku diebe.
Kiswahili: Kunawa mikono kwa maji na sabuni ni mojawapo ya njia bora za kulinda familia yako.

English (source): Never touch the body of someone who may have died from Ebola. Call a safe burial team.
Français: Ne touchez jamais le corps d'une personne qui a pu mourir d'Ebola. Appelez une équipe d'enterrement sécurisé.
Lingala – draft: Kosimba te ebembe ya moto oyo akoki kokufa na Ebola. Benga ekipe ya kokunda na bokebi.
Kikongo – draft: Simba ve ata fioti nitu ya muntu yina lenda vanda me fwa na Ebola. Binga ekipe ya kuzika na kukeba.
Tshiluba – draft: Kulengi nansha kakese mubidi wa muntu udi mua kufua ku Ebola to. Bikila ekipe wa kuziika ne bukokeshi.
Kiswahili: Usiguse kamwe mwili wa mtu ambaye huenda alikufa kwa Ebola. Piga simu kwa timu ya mazishi salama.

English (source): Malaria and Ebola can look the same at first. Only a lab test can tell.
Français: Le paludisme et Ebola peuvent se ressembler au début. Seul un test de laboratoire peut faire la différence.
Lingala – draft: Malaria mpe Ebola ekoki kokokana na ebandeli. Kaka laboratoire nde ekoki koyebisa.
Kikongo – draft: Malaria mpi Ebola lenda fwanana na lubantu. Kaka laboratoire lenda kuzabisa.
Tshiluba – draft: Malaria ne Ebola bidi mua kufuanangana ku ntuadijilu. Anu laboratoire ke udi mua kumanya.
Kiswahili: Malaria na Ebola zinaweza kufanana mwanzoni. Ni kipimo cha maabara pekee kinachoweza kutofautisha.

English (source): Tick everything that happened in the LAST 21 DAYS. If nothing applies, tap Next.
Français: Cochez tout ce qui s'est passé au cours des 21 DERNIERS JOURS. Si rien ne correspond, appuyez sur Suivant.
Lingala – draft: Pona nyonso oyo esalemaki na MIKOLO 21 OYO ELEKI. Soki eloko moko te, finá Landa.
Kikongo – draft: Pona mambu yonso yina salamaka na BILUMBU 21 YINA ME LUTA. Kana ata mosi ve, finda Landa.
Tshiluba – draft: Sungula malu onso avua menzeke mu MATUKU 21 AMANE KUPITA. Bikala kakuyi nansha umue, tua Tungunuka.
Kiswahili: Weka alama kwa yote yaliyotokea katika SIKU 21 ZILIZOPITA. Ikiwa hakuna, bonyeza Endelea.

English (source): Tick any symptoms you have NOW or that started recently. If none, tap See my result.
Français: Cochez les symptômes que vous avez MAINTENANT ou qui ont commencé récemment. Si aucun, appuyez sur Voir mon résultat.
Lingala – draft: Pona bilembo ozali na yango SIKOYO to oyo ebandi kala mingi te. Soki ezali te, finá Tala eyano na ngai.
Kikongo – draft: Pona bidimbu yina nge kele ti yo NTANGU YAI to yina me banda kele ve ntama. Kana ata mosi ve, finda Tala mvutu na mono.
Tshiluba – draft: Sungula bimanyinu biudi nabi KATATAKA anyi bidi bituadije kale kakese. Bikala kakuyi, tua Mona diandamuna dianyi.
Kiswahili: Weka alama kwa dalili ulizonazo SASA au zilizoanza hivi karibuni. Ikiwa hakuna, bonyeza Ona matokeo yangu.

English (source): In the last 21 days, have you lived in or travelled to an area with an active Ebola outbreak?
Français: Au cours des 21 derniers jours, avez-vous vécu ou voyagé dans une zone où il y a une épidémie d'Ebola ?
Lingala – draft: Na mikolo 21 oyo eleki, ofandaki to okendaki na esika oyo Ebola ezali kopanzana?
Kikongo – draft: Na bilumbu 21 yina me luta, nge vandaka to nge kwendaka na kisika yina Ebola ke panzana?
Tshiluba – draft: Mu matuku 21 amane kupita, uvua musombe anyi muye mu muaba udi Ebola ulengela bantu?
Kiswahili: Katika siku 21 zilizopita, uliishi au ulisafiri katika eneo lenye mlipuko wa Ebola?

English (source): Check your Ministry of Health or WHO for current outbreak areas.
Français: Consultez le ministère de la Santé ou l'OMS pour connaître les zones touchées.
Lingala – draft: Tala Ministère ya Santé to OMS mpo na koyeba bisika oyo Ebola ezali.
Kikongo – draft: Tala Ministère ya Santé to OMS sambu na kuzaba bisika yina Ebola kele.
Tshiluba – draft: Tangila Ministère wa Santé anyi OMS bua kumanya miaba idi Ebola.
Kiswahili: Angalia Wizara ya Afya au WHO kujua maeneo yenye mlipuko sasa.

English (source): Have you touched the blood or body fluids (vomit, stool, urine, saliva, sweat) of someone who was sick or died?
Français: Avez-vous touché le sang ou les liquides du corps (vomi, selles, urine, salive, sueur) d'une personne malade ou décédée ?
Lingala – draft: Osimbaki makila to mai ya nzoto (bisanza, nyei, masuba, soi, motoki) ya moto ya maladi to moto akufaki?
Kikongo – draft: Nge simbaka menga to mayi ya nitu (kuluka, tufi, masuba, mate, kitoko) ya muntu ya maladi to muntu yina fwaka?
Tshiluba – draft: Uvua mulenge mashi anyi mâyi a mubidi (kuluka, tumvi, masuba, mate, luvumbi) a muntu musama anyi muntu mufue?
Kiswahili: Uligusa damu au majimaji ya mwili (matapishi, kinyesi, mkojo, mate, jasho) ya mtu aliyekuwa mgonjwa au aliyefariki?

English (source): Have you cared for a sick person at home or in a health facility, or lived with someone who had Ebola?
Français: Avez-vous soigné une personne malade à la maison ou dans un centre de santé, ou vécu avec une personne qui avait Ebola ?
Lingala – draft: Obatelaki moto ya maladi na ndako to na lopitalo, to ofandaki na moto oyo azalaki na Ebola?
Kikongo – draft: Nge talaka muntu ya maladi na nzo to na lopitalo, to nge vandaka ti muntu yina vandaka ti Ebola?
Tshiluba – draft: Uvua mulame muntu musama ku nzubu anyi ku lopitalo, anyi musombe ne muntu uvua ne Ebola?
Kiswahili: Ulimhudumia mgonjwa nyumbani au katika kituo cha afya, au uliishi na mtu aliyekuwa na Ebola?

English (source): Have you attended a funeral or burial where you touched the body?
Français: Avez-vous assisté à des funérailles ou un enterrement où vous avez touché le corps ?
Lingala – draft: Okendaki na matanga to na kokunda epai osimbaki ebembe?
Kikongo – draft: Nge kwendaka na matanga to na kuzika kisika nge simbaka nitu ya mvumbi?
Tshiluba – draft: Uvua muye ku tshiladi anyi ku diziika muaba uvua mulenge mubidi wa mufue?
Kiswahili: Ulihudhuria msiba au mazishi ambapo uligusa mwili wa marehemu?

English (source): Have you handled bats, monkeys, apes or bushmeat (wild animal meat)?
Français: Avez-vous manipulé des chauves-souris, des singes ou de la viande de brousse ?
Lingala – draft: Osimbaki bangembo, bakewa, bamakako to nyama ya zamba?
Kikongo – draft: Nge simbaka bangembo, bankewa, bamakaku to mbisi ya musitu?
Tshiluba – draft: Uvua mulenge mpoyi (bangembo), nkima anyi nyama ya mu tshisuku?
Kiswahili: Ulishika popo, nyani, sokwe au nyama ya porini?

English (source): Have you had sexual contact with someone who recovered from Ebola?
Français: Avez-vous eu des rapports sexuels avec une personne guérie d'Ebola ?
Lingala – draft: Osangisaki nzoto na moto oyo abikaki na Ebola?
Kikongo – draft: Nge salaka kintwadi ya nitu ti muntu yina belukaka na Ebola?
Tshiluba – draft: Uvua mulale ne muntu uvua mupane ku Ebola?
Kiswahili: Ulifanya ngono na mtu aliyepona Ebola?

English (source): Fever (38 °C or higher) or feeling feverish
Français: Fièvre (38 °C ou plus) ou impression d'avoir de la fièvre
Lingala – draft: Fièvre (38 °C to koleka) to nzoto ya moto
Kikongo – draft: Fièvre (38 °C to kuluta) to nitu ya tiya
Tshiluba – draft: Fièvre (38 °C anyi kupita) anyi mubidi wa luya
Kiswahili: Homa (nyuzi 38 °C au zaidi) au kujisikia joto la homa

Français: Douleurs des muscles ou des articulations
Lingala – draft: Mpasi na misuni to na mikuwa
Kikongo – draft: Mpasi na bamisuni to na mabanga ya nitu
Tshiluba – draft: Kusama mu misuni anyi mu mafupa

Kiswahili: Udhaifu au uchovu usio wa kawaida

English (source): Unexplained bleeding or bruising (gums, nose, eyes, in vomit or stool)
Français: Saignements ou bleus inexpliqués (gencives, nez, yeux, dans le vomi ou les selles)
Lingala – draft: Makila ezali kobima to bilembo ya bleu na nzoto kozanga ntina (mino, zolo, miso, na bisanza to na nyei)
Kikongo – draft: Menga ke basika to bidimbu ya bleu na nitu kukonda kikuma (mazinu, mbombo, meso, na kuluka to na tufi)
Tshiluba – draft: Mashi adi apatuka anyi bimanyinu bia bleu ku mubidi kakuyi bualu (mishiku, mpala, mêsu, mu bia kuluka anyi mu tumvi)
Kiswahili: Kutoka damu au michubuko bila sababu (fizi, pua, macho, katika matapishi au kinyesi)

English (source): Ask the AI assistant about this
Français: Poser une question à l'assistant IA
Lingala – draft: Tuna mosalisi ya IA na ntina ya likambo oyo
Kikongo – draft: Yufula musadisi ya IA sambu na diambu yai
Tshiluba – draft: Konka muambuluishi wa IA bua bualu ebu
Kiswahili: Muulize msaidizi wa AI kuhusu hili

English (source): This result is guidance only, not a diagnosis. Only a laboratory test can confirm Ebola.
Français: Ce résultat est un conseil, pas un diagnostic. Seul un test de laboratoire peut confirmer Ebola.
Lingala – draft: Eyano oyo ezali toli kaka, ezali koyeba bokono te. Kaka laboratoire nde ekoki kondimisa Ebola.
Kikongo – draft: Mvutu yai kele kaka dilongi, yo kele ve kuzaba maladi. Kaka laboratoire lenda kundimisa Ebola.
Tshiluba – draft: Diandamuna edi ndibelu, kadiena dimanyisha disama to. Anu laboratoire ke udi mua kujadika Ebola.
Kiswahili: Matokeo haya ni ushauri tu, si utambuzi wa ugonjwa. Ni kipimo cha maabara pekee kinachoweza kuthibitisha Ebola.

Kikongo – draft: Sosa lusadisu ya munganga ntangu yai

English (source): You reported a possible exposure AND symptoms that can be seen with Ebola. This does not mean you have Ebola — many illnesses (like malaria) cause similar symptoms — but you should be checked by health workers right away.
Français: Vous avez signalé un contact possible ET des symptômes qui peuvent être liés à Ebola. Cela ne veut pas dire que vous avez Ebola — beaucoup de maladies (comme le paludisme) donnent des symptômes semblables — mais vous devez être examiné par des agents de santé tout de suite.
Lingala – draft: Oyebisi ete okoki kozala okutani na Ebola MPE ozali na bilembo oyo emonanaka na Ebola. Elingi koloba te ete ozali na Ebola — bokono mingi (lokola malaria) epesaka bilembo ya ndenge moko — kasi basali ya santé basengeli kotala yo mbala moko.
Kikongo – draft: Nge me zabisa nde nge lenda vanda me kutana ti Ebola MPI nge kele ti bidimbu yina ke monanaka na Ebola. Yo ke tendula ve nde nge kele ti Ebola — bamaladi mingi (bonso malaria) ke pesaka bidimbu ya mutindu mosi — kansi bantu ya santé fwete tala nge nswalu.
Tshiluba – draft: Wakamanyisha ne udi mua kuikala mupetangane ne Ebola NE udi ne bimanyinu bidi bimueneka ku Ebola. Kabiena biumvuija ne udi ne Ebola to — masama a bungi (bu malaria) adi afila bimanyinu bia muomumue — kadi bena mudimu wa santé badi ne bua kukutangila diakamue.
Kiswahili: Umeripoti uwezekano wa kuambukizwa NA dalili zinazoweza kuonekana kwa Ebola. Hii haimaanishi una Ebola — magonjwa mengi (kama malaria) yana dalili zinazofanana — lakini unapaswa kuchunguzwa na wahudumu wa afya mara moja.

English (source): Stay away from other people, including family, as much as you can.
Français: Restez à l’écart des autres personnes, y compris votre famille, autant que possible.
Lingala – draft: Kabwana na bato mosusu, ata libota na yo, ndenge okoki.
Kikongo – draft: Vanda ntama ti bantu yankaka, ata dibuta na nge, mutindu nge lenda.
Tshiluba – draft: Ikala kule ne bantu bakuabu, nansha dîku diebe, nunku muudi mua kukokesha.
Kiswahili: Kaa mbali na watu wengine, pamoja na familia, kadiri uwezavyo.

English (source): Call the health hotline or emergency number NOW and tell them your symptoms and possible exposure.
Français: Appelez MAINTENANT la ligne d'urgence sanitaire et décrivez vos symptômes et le contact possible.
Lingala – draft: Benga SIKOYO numero ya mbangu ya santé mpe yebisa bango bilembo na yo mpe bokutani.
Kikongo – draft: Binga NTANGU YAI numero ya nswalu ya santé mpi zabisa bo bidimbu na nge mpi kukutana.
Tshiluba – draft: Bikila KATATAKA numero wa lukasa wa santé ne ubamanyishe bimanyinu biebe ne dipetangana.
Kiswahili: Piga simu SASA kwa namba ya dharura ya afya na ueleze dalili zako na uwezekano wa kuambukizwa.

English (source): Do not go to a clinic or hospital without calling first, so staff can prepare to receive you safely.
Français: N'allez pas dans un centre de santé ou un hôpital sans appeler avant, pour que le personnel puisse vous recevoir en sécurité.
Lingala – draft: Kende na lopitalo te liboso ya kobenga, mpo basali babongisa koyamba yo na bokebi.
Kikongo – draft: Kwenda ve na lopitalo ntete ya kubinga, sambu bantu ya kisalu kubongisa kuyamba nge na kukeba.
Tshiluba – draft: Kuyi ku lopitalo kumpala kua kubikila to, bua bena mudimu badilongolole bua kukuakidila ne bukokeshi.
Kiswahili: Usiende kliniki au hospitali bila kupiga simu kwanza, ili wahudumu wajiandae kukupokea kwa usalama.

Français: Ne prenez pas les transports en commun.
Lingala – draft: Kotambola na motuka ya bato nyonso te.
Kikongo – draft: Kutambula ve na kamio to bisi ya bantu yonso.
Tshiluba – draft: Kuendi mu mashinyi a bantu bonso to.

English (source): Do not share towels, utensils or bedding. Keep your body fluids away from others.
Français: Ne partagez pas serviettes, couverts ou draps. Gardez vos liquides du corps loin des autres.
Lingala – draft: Kokabola te bilamba ya komipangusa, bisani to bilamba ya mbeto. Batela mai ya nzoto na yo mosika na bato.
Kikongo – draft: Kabula ve bilele ya kudipangusa, bisani to bilele ya mbeto. Keba nde mayi ya nitu na nge kukwenda ve na bantu.
Tshiluba – draft: Kuabanyi bilamba bia kudikupula, bintu bia kudila anyi bilamba bia ku bulalu to. Lama mâyi a mubidi webe kule ne bantu.
Kiswahili: Usishiriki taulo, vyombo au matandiko. Weka majimaji ya mwili wako mbali na wengine.

English (source): You reported a possible exposure but no symptoms right now. People with Ebola are not contagious before symptoms start, but symptoms can appear up to 21 days after exposure.
Français: Vous avez signalé un contact possible mais pas de symptômes pour l'instant. Une personne atteinte d'Ebola n'est pas contagieuse avant les symptômes, mais ceux-ci peuvent apparaître jusqu'à 21 jours après le contact.
Lingala – draft: Oyebisi bokutani oyo ekoki kozala kasi ozali na bilembo te sikoyo. Moto ya Ebola apesaka bokono te liboso ya bilembo, kasi bilembo ekoki kobima kino mikolo 21 nsima ya bokutani.
Kikongo – draft: Nge me zabisa kukutana yina lenda vanda kansi nge kele ve ti bidimbu ntangu yai. Muntu ya Ebola ke pesaka ve maladi ntete ya bidimbu, kansi bidimbu lenda basika tii bilumbu 21 na nima ya kukutana.
Tshiluba – draft: Wakamanyisha dipetangana didi mua kuikala kadi kuena ne bimanyinu katataka. Muntu wa Ebola kena ukuatshisha bakuabu kumpala kua bimanyinu to, kadi bimanyinu bidi mua kumueneka too ne matuku 21 panyima pa dipetangana.
Kiswahili: Umeripoti uwezekano wa kuambukizwa lakini huna dalili sasa. Watu wenye Ebola hawaambukizi kabla ya dalili, lakini dalili zinaweza kutokea hadi siku 21 baada ya kuambukizwa.

English (source): Take your temperature twice a day for 21 days after your last possible exposure.
Français: Prenez votre température deux fois par jour pendant 21 jours après le dernier contact possible.
Lingala – draft: Meka molunge ya nzoto na yo mbala mibale na mokolo, mikolo 21 nsima ya bokutani ya suka.
Kikongo – draft: Tala tiya ya nitu na nge mbala zole na kilumbu, bilumbu 21 na nima ya kukutana ya nsuka.
Tshiluba – draft: Pima luya lua mubidi webe misangu ibidi ku dituku, matuku 21 panyima pa dipetangana dia ndekelu.
Kiswahili: Pima joto lako mara mbili kwa siku kwa siku 21 baada ya tukio la mwisho la uwezekano wa kuambukizwa.

English (source): Contact your local health department and follow their instructions.
Français: Contactez le service de santé local et suivez ses instructions.
Lingala – draft: Benga basali ya santé ya esika na yo mpe landa toli na bango.
Kikongo – draft: Binga bantu ya santé ya kisika na nge mpi landa malongi na bo.
Tshiluba – draft: Bikila bena mudimu wa santé ba muaba webe ne londa mibelu yabu.
Kiswahili: Wasiliana na idara ya afya ya eneo lako na ufuate maelekezo yao.

English (source): If you develop a fever or any symptom, separate yourself from others and call the hotline immediately.
Français: Si vous avez de la fièvre ou un symptôme, éloignez-vous des autres et appelez immédiatement la ligne d'urgence.
Lingala – draft: Soki ozwi fièvre to elembo moko, kabwana na bato mpe benga noki numero ya mbangu.
Kikongo – draft: Kana nge me baka fièvre to kidimbu mosi, kabuka na bantu mpi binga nswalu numero ya nswalu.
Tshiluba – draft: Biwapeta fièvre anyi tshimanyinu tshimue, dikosa ku bantu ne bikila lukasa numero wa lukasa.
Kiswahili: Ukipata homa au dalili yoyote, jitenge na wengine na upige simu mara moja kwa namba ya dharura.

English (source): Avoid touching anyone's blood or body fluids and do not handle the bodies of people who died.
Français: Évitez de toucher le sang ou les liquides du corps des autres et ne manipulez pas le corps des personnes décédées.
Lingala – draft: Kosimba te makila to mai ya nzoto ya moto mosusu mpe kosimba te bibembe.
Kikongo – draft: Simba ve menga to mayi ya nitu ya muntu mosi mpi simba ve bamvumbi.
Tshiluba – draft: Kulengi mashi anyi mâyi a mubidi a muntu mukuabu to ne kulengi mibidi ya bafue to.
Kiswahili: Epuka kugusa damu au majimaji ya mwili ya mtu yeyote na usishike miili ya watu waliofariki.

Français: Consultez un agent de santé aujourd'hui

English (source): You did not report a possible Ebola exposure, so Ebola is unlikely. Your symptoms can still be caused by other illnesses (such as malaria or typhoid) that need treatment.
Français: Vous n'avez pas signalé de contact possible avec Ebola, donc Ebola est peu probable. Vos symptômes peuvent être dus à d'autres maladies (comme le paludisme ou la typhoïde) qui doivent être soignées.
Lingala – draft: Oyebisi bokutani na Ebola te, yango wana Ebola ekoki kozala mingi te. Kasi bilembo na yo ekoki kouta na bokono mosusu (lokola malaria to typhoïde) oyo esengeli kosalisama.
Kikongo – draft: Nge me zabisa ve kukutana ti Ebola, yo yina Ebola lenda vanda mingi ve. Kansi bidimbu na nge lenda katuka na bamaladi yankaka (bonso malaria to typhoïde) yina fwete belusama.
Tshiluba – draft: Kuena mumanyishe dipetangana ne Ebola to, nunku Ebola kena mua kuikala bikole to. Kadi bimanyinu biebe bidi mua kufuma ku masama makuabu (bu malaria anyi typhoïde) adi ne bua kuondapibua.
Kiswahili: Hukuripoti uwezekano wa kuambukizwa Ebola, kwa hiyo Ebola haiwezekani sana. Dalili zako bado zinaweza kusababishwa na magonjwa mengine (kama malaria au homa ya matumbo) yanayohitaji matibabu.

English (source): Unexplained bleeding needs medical attention today — go to a clinic or call for help.
Français: Un saignement inexpliqué demande des soins aujourd'hui — allez dans un centre de santé ou appelez à l'aide.
Lingala – draft: Makila oyo ebimi kozanga ntina esengeli kotalama lelo — kende na lopitalo to benga mpo na lisalisi.
Kikongo – draft: Menga yina ke basika kukonda kikuma fwete talama bubu — kwenda na lopitalo to binga sambu na lusadisu.
Tshiluba – draft: Mashi adi apatuka kakuyi bualu adi ne bua kutangidibua lelu — ya ku lopitalo anyi bikila bua kuambuluishibua.
Kiswahili: Kutoka damu bila sababu kunahitaji matibabu leo — nenda kliniki au piga simu kuomba msaada.

English (source): Visit a clinic or health worker to find the cause of your symptoms.
Français: Allez voir un agent de santé pour trouver la cause de vos symptômes.
Lingala – draft: Kende na lopitalo to epai ya mosali ya santé mpo na koyeba ntina ya bilembo na yo.
Kikongo – draft: Kwenda na lopitalo to na muntu ya santé sambu na kuzaba kikuma ya bidimbu na nge.
Tshiluba – draft: Ya ku lopitalo anyi kudi muena mudimu wa santé bua kumanya tshidi tshifila bimanyinu biebe.
Kiswahili: Tembelea kliniki au mhudumu wa afya ili kujua chanzo cha dalili zako.

English (source): Drink plenty of safe water to avoid dehydration.
Français: Buvez beaucoup d'eau potable pour éviter la déshydratation.
Lingala – draft: Mela mai ya peto mingi mpo nzoto ekauka te.
Kikongo – draft: Nwa mayi ya mbote mingi sambu nitu kuyuma ve.
Tshiluba – draft: Nua mâyi malenga a bungi bua mubidi kawumi to.
Kiswahili: Kunywa maji safi mengi ili kuepuka upungufu wa maji mwilini.

English (source): If you remember a possible exposure later, do this check again and call the hotline.
Français: Si vous vous souvenez plus tard d'un contact possible, refaites ce test et appelez la ligne d'urgence.
Lingala – draft: Soki omikundoli na nsima bokutani moko, meka lisusu mpe benga numero ya mbangu.
Kikongo – draft: Kana nge me yibuka na nima kukutana mosi, tala diaka mpi binga numero ya nswalu.
Tshiluba – draft: Biwavuluka panyima dipetangana dimue, konkonona kabidi ne bikila numero wa lukasa.
Kiswahili: Ukikumbuka baadaye uwezekano wa kuambukizwa, fanya uchunguzi huu tena na upige simu kwa namba ya dharura.

Français: Peu de risque pour le moment

English (source): You did not report a possible exposure or symptoms. Keep following prevention advice, especially if you live in or travel to an outbreak area.
Français: Vous n'avez signalé ni contact possible ni symptôme. Continuez à suivre les conseils de prévention, surtout si vous vivez ou voyagez dans une zone touchée.
Lingala – draft: Oyebisi bokutani te mpe bilembo te. Kobá kolanda toli ya kobatela, mingimingi soki ofandi to okendaka na esika ya Ebola.
Kikongo – draft: Nge me zabisa ve kukutana to bidimbu. Landa kaka malongi ya kukeba, mingi-mingi kana nge ke vandaka to ke kwendaka na kisika ya Ebola.
Tshiluba – draft: Kuena mumanyishe dipetangana anyi bimanyinu to. Tungunuka ne kulonda mibelu ya kudilama, nangananga biwikala usomba anyi uya mu muaba wa Ebola.
Kiswahili: Hukuripoti uwezekano wa kuambukizwa wala dalili. Endelea kufuata ushauri wa kinga, hasa ukiishi au kusafiri katika eneo lenye mlipuko.

English (source): Wash your hands often with soap and water.
Français: Lavez-vous souvent les mains avec de l'eau et du savon.
Lingala – draft: Sukola maboko mbala na mbala na mai mpe sabuni.
Kikongo – draft: Sukula maboko mbala na mbala na mayi mpi savuni.
Tshiluba – draft: Owa bianza misangu yonso ne mâyi ne disabu.
Kiswahili: Nawa mikono mara kwa mara kwa maji na sabuni.

English (source): Avoid contact with blood and body fluids of sick people.
Français: Évitez tout contact avec le sang et les liquides du corps des personnes malades.
Lingala – draft: Kosimba te makila mpe mai ya nzoto ya bato ya maladi.
Kikongo – draft: Simba ve menga mpi mayi ya nitu ya bantu ya maladi.
Tshiluba – draft: Kulengi mashi ne mâyi a mubidi a bantu basama to.
Kiswahili: Epuka kugusa damu na majimaji ya mwili ya wagonjwa.

English (source): Avoid handling bushmeat, bats and primates.
Français: Évitez de manipuler la viande de brousse, les chauves-souris et les singes.
Lingala – draft: Kosimba te nyama ya zamba, bangembo mpe bakewa.
Kikongo – draft: Simba ve mbisi ya musitu, bangembo mpi bankewa.
Tshiluba – draft: Kulengi nyama ya mu tshisuku, mpoyi ne nkima to.
Kiswahili: Epuka kushika nyama ya porini, popo na nyani.

English (source): Do this check again if anything changes.
Français: Refaites ce test si quelque chose change.
Lingala – draft: Meka lisusu soki likambo moko ebongwani.
Kikongo – draft: Tala diaka kana diambu mosi me soba.
Kiswahili: Fanya uchunguzi huu tena kitu chochote kikibadilika.

English (source): Hello! I can answer questions about Ebola: symptoms, how it spreads, prevention and what to do if you are worried. I can't diagnose you. What would you like to know?
Français: Bonjour ! Je peux répondre à vos questions sur Ebola : symptômes, transmission, prévention et que faire si vous êtes inquiet. Je ne peux pas faire de diagnostic. Que voulez-vous savoir ?
Lingala – draft: Mbote! Nakoki koyanola mituna na ntina ya Ebola: bilembo, ndenge ekendaka, kobatela mpe nini kosala soki ozali na mitungisi. Nakoki koyebisa yo bokono te. Olingi koyeba nini?
Kikongo – draft: Mbote! Mono lenda vutula bangyufula sambu na Ebola: bidimbu, mutindu yo ke kwendaka, kukeba mpi inki kusala kana nge kele ti boma. Mono lenda kuzabisa nge maladi ve. Nge ke zola kuzaba inki?
Tshiluba – draft: Moyo! Ndi mua kuandamuna ku nkonko ya Ebola: bimanyinu, mushindu udiye uya, kudilama ne tshia kuenza biwikala ne bualu. Tshiena mua kukumanyisha disama to. Udi musue kumanya tshinyi?
Kiswahili: Habari! Naweza kujibu maswali kuhusu Ebola: dalili, jinsi inavyoenea, kinga na nini cha kufanya ukiwa na wasiwasi. Siwezi kukutambua ugonjwa. Ungependa kujua nini?

English (source): I can see your screening result. Ask me anything about it — for example what the symptoms mean or how to protect your family.
Français: Je vois votre résultat du test. Posez-moi vos questions — par exemple ce que veulent dire les symptômes ou comment protéger votre famille.
Lingala – draft: Namoni eyano ya komeka na yo. Tuna ngai nyonso — ndakisa ntina ya bilembo to ndenge ya kobatela libota na yo.
Kikongo – draft: Mono me mona mvutu ya kutala na nge. Yufula mono yonso — mbandu tendula ya bidimbu to mutindu ya kukeba dibuta na nge.
Tshiluba – draft: Ndi mumone diandamuna dia kukonkonona kuebe. Nkonka bualu buonso — tshilejilu tshidi bimanyinu biumvuija anyi mushindu wa kulama dîku diebe.
Kiswahili: Naona matokeo ya uchunguzi wako. Niulize chochote kuhusu hayo — kwa mfano dalili zina maana gani au jinsi ya kulinda familia yako.

English (source): AI answers can be wrong. Long-press an answer to hear it or report it.
Français: Les réponses de l'IA peuvent être fausses. Appuyez longuement sur une réponse pour l'écouter ou la signaler.
Lingala – draft: Biyano ya IA ekoki kozala ya libunga. Finá eyano mpo na koyoka yango to koyebisa libunga.
Kikongo – draft: Bamvutu ya IA lenda vanda ya foti. Finda mvutu sambu na kuwa yo to kuzabisa foti.
Tshiluba – draft: Mandamuna a IA adi mua kuikala ne bilema. Tua bikole pa diandamuna bua kudiumvua anyi kumanyisha tshilema.
Kiswahili: Majibu ya AI yanaweza kuwa si sahihi. Bonyeza jibu kwa muda mrefu ili kulisikiliza au kuliripoti.

Lingala – draft: Ya lokuta, ya likama to ya mabe
Kikongo – draft: Ya luvunu, ya kigonsa to ya mbi
Tshiluba – draft: Dia dishima, dia njiwu anyi dibi
Kiswahili: Si sahihi, hatari au la kuudhi

English (source): Thank you. The answer was reported.
Français: Merci. La réponse a été signalée.

English (source): The assistant took too long to answer. Please try again.
Français: L'assistant a mis trop de temps à répondre. Réessayez.
Kikongo – draft: Musadisi me zinga na kuvutula. Meka diaka.
Tshiluba – draft: Muambuluishi mulepele bua kuandamuna. Teta kabidi.
Kiswahili: Msaidizi amechelewa kujibu. Tafadhali jaribu tena.

English (source): Cannot reach the assistant. Check your internet connection and try again.
Français: Impossible de joindre l'assistant. Vérifiez votre connexion Internet et réessayez.
Lingala – draft: Tokoki kokutana na mosalisi te. Tala internet na yo mpe meka lisusu.
Kikongo – draft: Beto me kuka ve kukutana ti musadisi. Tala internet na nge mpi meka diaka.
Tshiluba – draft: Katuena mua kupeta muambuluishi to. Tangila internet webe ne teta kabidi.
Kiswahili: Imeshindwa kumfikia msaidizi. Angalia intaneti yako na ujaribu tena.

English (source): The assistant returned an empty answer.
Français: L'assistant a renvoyé une réponse vide.

English (source): Could not send the report. Please try again later.
Français: Impossible d'envoyer le signalement. Réessayez plus tard.
Lingala – draft: Tokoki kotinda te. Meka lisusu na nsima.
Kikongo – draft: Beto me kuka ve kutinda. Meka diaka na nima.
Tshiluba – draft: Katuena mua kutuma to. Teta kabidi panyima.
Kiswahili: Imeshindwa kutuma ripoti. Tafadhali jaribu baadaye.

English (source):
Ask in your own words, for example:
"How does Ebola spread?"
"What should I do if my brother has a fever?"
Français:
Posez votre question avec vos mots, par exemple :
« Comment se transmet Ebola ? »
« Que faire si mon frère a de la fièvre ? »
Lingala – draft:
Tuna na maloba na yo, ndakisa:
"Ebola ekendaka ndenge nini?"
"Nasala nini soki ndeko na ngai azali na fièvre?"
Kikongo – draft:
Yufula na bangogo na nge, mbandu:
"Ebola ke kwendaka mutindu nki?"
"Mono sala nki kana mpangi na mono kele ti fièvre?"
Tshiluba – draft:
Konka ne miaku iebe, tshilejilu:
"Ebola udi uya mushindu kayi?"
"Ngenze tshinyi muanetu biikala ne fièvre?"
Kiswahili:
Uliza kwa maneno yako, kwa mfano:
"Ebola huenea vipi?"
"Nifanye nini kaka yangu akiwa na homa?"

English (source): Tap the microphone and ask your question
Français: Appuyez sur le micro et posez votre question
Lingala – draft: Finá micro mpe tuna motuna na yo
Kikongo – draft: Finda micro mpi yufula ngyufula na nge
Tshiluba – draft: Tua micro ne konka lukonko luebe
Kiswahili: Bonyeza kipaza sauti na uulize swali lako

English (source): Listening… tap again when you finish
Français: J'écoute… appuyez à nouveau quand vous avez fini
Lingala – draft: Nazali koyoka… finá lisusu soki osilisi
Kikongo – draft: Mono ke wa… finda diaka kana nge me mana

Lingala – draft: Nazali koloba… finá mpo na kotelemisa
Kikongo – draft: Mono ke tuba… finda sambu na kukanga

English (source): AI answers can be wrong. Not a diagnosis.
Français: Les réponses de l'IA peuvent être fausses. Ce n'est pas un diagnostic.
Lingala – draft: Biyano ya IA ekoki kozala ya libunga. Ezali koyeba bokono te.
Kikongo – draft: Bamvutu ya IA lenda vanda ya foti. Yo kele ve kuzaba maladi.
Tshiluba – draft: Mandamuna a IA adi mua kuikala ne bilema. Kadiena dimanyisha disama to.
Kiswahili: Majibu ya AI yanaweza kuwa si sahihi. Si utambuzi wa ugonjwa.

English (source): Voice is not available. Please allow microphone access in your phone settings (Settings → Apps → Ebola Guard → Permissions), and make sure the Google app or another speech service is installed. You can still use the text chat.
Français: La voix n'est pas disponible. Autorisez le micro dans les paramètres du téléphone (Paramètres → Applications → Ebola Guard → Autorisations) et vérifiez que l'application Google ou un autre service vocal est installé. Vous pouvez toujours utiliser le chat écrit.
Lingala – draft: Mongongo ezali te. Pesa ndingisa ya micro na paramètres ya telefone (Paramètres → Applications → Ebola Guard → Autorisations), mpe tala soki application Google ezali. Okoki kaka kosalela kokoma.
Kikongo – draft: Ndinga kele ve. Pesa nswa ya micro na paramètres ya telefone (Paramètres → Applications → Ebola Guard → Autorisations), mpi tala kana application Google kele. Nge lenda sadila kaka kusonika.
Tshiluba – draft: Dîyi kadiena to. Fila dianyisha dia micro mu paramètres a telefone (Paramètres → Applications → Ebola Guard → Autorisations), ne tangila ne application Google udiku. Udi mua kuenza mudimu anu ne kufunda.
Kiswahili: Sauti haipatikani. Ruhusu kipaza sauti katika mipangilio ya simu (Mipangilio → Programu → Ebola Guard → Ruhusa), na hakikisha programu ya Google au huduma nyingine ya sauti imesakinishwa. Bado unaweza kutumia gumzo la maandishi.

English (source): I did not hear anything. Tap the microphone and try again.
Français: Je n'ai rien entendu. Appuyez sur le micro et réessayez.
Lingala – draft: Nayoki eloko te. Finá micro mpe meka lisusu.
Kikongo – draft: Mono me wa ata kima ve. Finda micro mpi meka diaka.
Tshiluba – draft: Tshiena mumvue tshintu to. Tua micro ne teta kabidi.
Kiswahili: Sikusikia chochote. Bonyeza kipaza sauti na ujaribu tena.

English (source): Choose the language you will speak
Français: Choisissez la langue dans laquelle vous allez parler
Kikongo – draft: Pona ndinga yina nge ta tuba
Tshiluba – draft: Sungula muakulu uudi ne bua kuakula

English (source): Your phone cannot listen in this language yet. Speak French or English, or use the text chat.
Français: Votre téléphone ne peut pas encore écouter cette langue. Parlez en français ou en anglais, ou utilisez le chat écrit.
Lingala – draft: Telefone na yo ekoki naino koyoka Lingala te. Loba na Lifalanse to Lingelesi, to salela kokoma.
Kikongo – draft: Telefone na nge lenda wa ntete ve Kikongo. Tuba na Fwalansa to Angele, to sadila kusonika.
Tshiluba – draft: Telefone webe kena mua kumvua Tshiluba to. Akula mu Mfualansa anyi Angele, anyi enza mudimu ne kufunda.
Kiswahili: Simu yako bado haiwezi kusikiliza lugha hii. Ongea Kifaransa au Kiingereza, au tumia gumzo la maandishi.

English (source): 7 ways to protect yourself and your family
Français: 7 façons de vous protéger, vous et votre famille
Lingala – draft: Makambo 7 mpo na komibatela yo mpe libota na yo
Kikongo – draft: Mambu 7 sambu na kudikeba nge mpi dibuta na nge
Tshiluba – draft: Malu 7 bua kudilama wewe ne dîku diebe
Kiswahili: Njia 7 za kujikinga wewe na familia yako

English (source): Hand washing removes the virus before it can enter your eyes, nose or mouth.
Français: Le lavage des mains enlève le virus avant qu'il n'entre par les yeux, le nez ou la bouche.
Lingala – draft: Kosukola maboko elongolaka virus liboso ekota na miso, zolo to monoko.
Kiswahili: Kunawa mikono huondoa virusi kabla havijaingia machoni, puani au mdomoni.

English (source): Wash with soap and clean water for at least 20 seconds, or use alcohol hand rub.
Français: Lavez-vous les mains avec de l'eau propre et du savon pendant au moins 20 secondes, ou utilisez une solution hydroalcoolique.
Lingala – draft: Sukola na sabuni mpe mai ya peto mwa basekonde 20, to salela alcool ya maboko.
Kiswahili: Nawa kwa sabuni na maji safi kwa angalau sekunde 20, au tumia kitakasa mikono chenye pombe.

English (source): Always wash after caring for a sick person, touching their things, using the toilet, and before eating.
Français: Lavez-vous toujours les mains après avoir soigné un malade, touché ses affaires, utilisé les toilettes, et avant de manger.
Lingala – draft: Sukola ntango nyonso nsima ya kobatela moto ya maladi, kosimba biloko na ye, kokende na WC, mpe liboso ya kolya.
Kiswahili: Nawa kila mara baada ya kumhudumia mgonjwa, kugusa vitu vyake, kutumia choo, na kabla ya kula.

English (source): Where health teams provide them, use hand-washing stations at homes, schools, churches and markets.
Français: Utilisez les postes de lavage des mains installés dans les maisons, écoles, églises et marchés.
Lingala – draft: Salela bisika ya kosukola maboko na bandako, na eteyelo, na lingomba mpe na zando.
Kiswahili: Tumia vituo vya kunawa mikono vilivyowekwa majumbani, shuleni, makanisani na sokoni.

Français: Évitez le sang et les liquides du corps
Lingala – draft: Kosimba te makila mpe mai ya nzoto
Kikongo – draft: Simba ve menga mpi mayi ya nitu
Tshiluba – draft: Kulengi mashi ne mâyi a mubidi to
Kiswahili: Epuka damu na majimaji ya mwili

English (source): Ebola spreads through blood, vomit, stool, urine, saliva, sweat, breast milk and semen of a sick person.
Français: Ebola se transmet par le sang, le vomi, les selles, l'urine, la salive, la sueur, le lait maternel et le sperme d'une personne malade.
Lingala – draft: Ebola ekendaka na makila, bisanza, nyei, masuba, soi, motoki, mabele mpe mai ya mobali ya moto ya maladi.
Kiswahili: Ebola huenea kupitia damu, matapishi, kinyesi, mkojo, mate, jasho, maziwa ya mama na shahawa za mgonjwa.

English (source): Do not touch a person who may have Ebola, or their bedding, clothes or needles.
Français: Ne touchez pas une personne qui a peut-être Ebola, ni ses draps, vêtements ou aiguilles.
Lingala – draft: Kosimba te moto oyo akoki kozala na Ebola, ata bilamba, mbeto to batonga na ye.
Kiswahili: Usimguse mtu ambaye huenda ana Ebola, wala matandiko, nguo au sindano zake.

English (source): If you must help someone, wear gloves and avoid splashes to your face, then wash your hands.
Français: Si vous devez aider quelqu'un, portez des gants, évitez les éclaboussures au visage, puis lavez-vous les mains.
Lingala – draft: Soki osengeli kosalisa moto, lata ba gants, keba mai ebeta yo na elongi te, nsima sukola maboko.
Kiswahili: Ukilazimika kumsaidia mtu, vaa glavu na epuka majimaji kurukia uso wako, kisha nawa mikono.

English (source): Call the health hotline so trained teams can take the sick person to care.
Français: Appelez la ligne d'urgence pour que des équipes formées emmènent le malade se faire soigner.
Lingala – draft: Benga numero ya mbangu mpo bato bayekoli bamema moto ya maladi na kosalisama.
Kiswahili: Piga simu kwa namba ya dharura ili timu zilizofunzwa zimpeleke mgonjwa kutibiwa.

English (source): Early care at an Ebola treatment centre greatly improves the chance of survival and protects your family.
Français: Des soins précoces dans un centre de traitement Ebola augmentent beaucoup les chances de survie et protègent votre famille.
Lingala – draft: Kosalisama noki na centre ya Ebola ebakisaka mingi libaku ya kobika mpe ebatelaka libota na yo.
Kiswahili: Matibabu ya mapema katika kituo cha Ebola huongeza sana nafasi ya kupona na hulinda familia yako.

English (source): If someone has a fever after possible contact, keep them apart from others and call the hotline.
Français: Si une personne a de la fièvre après un contact possible, éloignez-la des autres et appelez la ligne d'urgence.
Lingala – draft: Soki moto azali na fièvre nsima ya bokutani, kabola ye na bato mosusu mpe benga numero ya mbangu.
Kiswahili: Mtu akiwa na homa baada ya uwezekano wa kuambukizwa, mtenge na wengine na upige simu kwa namba ya dharura.

English (source): Do not hide sick people at home or take them to traditional healers.
Français: Ne cachez pas les malades à la maison et ne les emmenez pas chez un guérisseur.
Lingala – draft: Kobomba te bato ya maladi na ndako mpe komema bango te epai ya banganga-nkisi.
Kiswahili: Usiwafiche wagonjwa nyumbani wala kuwapeleka kwa waganga wa kienyeji.

English (source): Call before going to a clinic so staff can receive you safely.
Français: Appelez avant d'aller dans un centre de santé pour que le personnel vous reçoive en sécurité.
Lingala – draft: Benga liboso ya kokende na lopitalo mpo bayamba yo na bokebi.
Kiswahili: Piga simu kabla ya kwenda kliniki ili wahudumu wakupokee kwa usalama.

Lingala – draft: Kokunda na bokebi mpe na lokumu
Kikongo – draft: Kuzika na kukeba mpi na lukumu
Tshiluba – draft: Kuziika ne bukokeshi ne ne kanemu

English (source): The bodies of people who died from Ebola are very infectious. Many people have been infected at funerals.
Français: Le corps d'une personne morte d'Ebola est très contagieux. Beaucoup de personnes ont été infectées lors de funérailles.
Lingala – draft: Bibembe ya bato bakufi na Ebola epesaka bokono makasi. Bato mingi bazwaki bokono na matanga.
Kiswahili: Miili ya watu waliokufa kwa Ebola huambukiza sana. Watu wengi wameambukizwa kwenye misiba.

English (source): Do not wash, touch or kiss the body of a person who may have died from Ebola.
Français: Ne lavez pas, ne touchez pas et n'embrassez pas le corps d'une personne qui a pu mourir d'Ebola.
Lingala – draft: Kosukola te, kosimba te mpe kopesa beze te ebembe ya moto oyo akoki kokufa na Ebola.
Kiswahili: Usiuoshe, usiuguse wala usiubusu mwili wa mtu ambaye huenda alikufa kwa Ebola.

English (source): Call the hotline: trained burial teams can give a safe and dignified burial, respecting your traditions.
Français: Appelez la ligne d'urgence : des équipes formées font un enterrement sécurisé et digne, dans le respect de vos traditions.
Lingala – draft: Benga numero ya mbangu: bato bayekoli bakoki kokunda na bokebi mpe na lokumu, na kotosa bizaleli na bino.
Kiswahili: Piga simu kwa namba ya dharura: timu zilizofunzwa zinaweza kufanya mazishi salama na yenye heshima, kwa kuheshimu mila zenu.

English (source): Fruit bats are natural carriers, and monkeys and apes can also be infected.
Français: Les chauves-souris frugivores portent naturellement le virus, et les singes peuvent aussi être infectés.
Lingala – draft: Bangembo oyo balyaka mbuma bamemaka virus, mpe bakewa mpe bamakako bakoki kozwa yango.
Kiswahili: Popo wanaokula matunda hubeba virusi kwa asili, na nyani na sokwe pia wanaweza kuambukizwa.

English (source): Do not touch or eat bats, monkeys or apes, or animals found dead.
Français: Ne touchez pas et ne mangez pas de chauves-souris, de singes ou d’animaux trouvés morts.
Lingala – draft: Kosimba te mpe kolya te bangembo, bakewa, bamakako to banyama oyo bakutami bakufi.
Kiswahili: Usiguse wala usile popo, nyani, sokwe au wanyama waliokutwa wamekufa.

English (source): If you handle animal meat, wear gloves and cook it thoroughly.
Français: Si vous manipulez de la viande d'animal, portez des gants et faites-la bien cuire.
Lingala – draft: Soki osimbi nyama, lata ba gants mpe lamba yango malamu.
Kiswahili: Ukishika nyama ya mnyama, vaa glavu na uipike vizuri.

English (source): A vaccine protects against one type of Ebola virus (Zaire) and is offered to contacts and health workers during outbreaks.
Français: Un vaccin protège contre un type de virus Ebola (Zaïre). Il est proposé aux contacts et aux agents de santé pendant les épidémies.
Lingala – draft: Mangwele moko ebatelaka na lolenge moko ya virus Ebola (Zaïre). Bapesaka yango na bato bakutanaki na bato ya maladi mpe na basali ya santé.
Kiswahili: Chanjo hulinda dhidi ya aina moja ya virusi vya Ebola (Zaire) na hutolewa kwa waliokutana na wagonjwa na wahudumu wa afya wakati wa milipuko.

English (source): If health workers offer you a vaccine, ask them about it — it is free during outbreaks.
Français: Si des agents de santé vous proposent un vaccin, posez-leur vos questions — il est gratuit pendant les épidémies.
Lingala – draft: Soki basali ya santé bapesi yo mangwele, tuna bango mituna — ezali ofele na ntango ya bokono.
Kiswahili: Wahudumu wa afya wakikupa chanjo, waulize maswali — ni bure wakati wa milipuko.

English (source): There is no vaccine yet for every type of Ebola (for example Bundibugyo), so keep following the other steps.
Français: Il n'existe pas encore de vaccin pour tous les types d'Ebola (par exemple Bundibugyo) : continuez à suivre les autres conseils.
Lingala – draft: Mangwele ezali naino te mpo na mitindo nyonso ya Ebola (ndakisa Bundibugyo), yango wana kobá kolanda makambo mosusu.
Kiswahili: Bado hakuna chanjo kwa kila aina ya Ebola (kwa mfano Bundibugyo), kwa hiyo endelea kufuata hatua nyingine.

English (source): Recovered people are not contagious through everyday contact, but the virus can stay in semen for months.
Français: Les personnes guéries ne sont pas contagieuses dans la vie de tous les jours, mais le virus peut rester des mois dans le sperme.
Lingala – draft: Bato babikaki bapesaka bokono te na bomoi ya mokolo na mokolo, kasi virus ekoki kotikala sanza mingi na mai ya mobali.
Kiswahili: Waliopona hawaambukizi kwa mawasiliano ya kila siku, lakini virusi vinaweza kubaki kwenye shahawa kwa miezi kadhaa.

English (source): Welcome survivors back — stigma makes people hide symptoms.
Français: Accueillez les survivants — la stigmatisation pousse les gens à cacher leurs symptômes.
Lingala – draft: Yamba bato babikaki — kotiola bango esalaka ete bato babomba bilembo.
Kiswahili: Wapokee waliopona — unyanyapaa huwafanya watu waficha dalili.

English (source): Male survivors should use condoms and follow the survivor programme's testing advice.
Français: Les hommes guéris doivent utiliser des préservatifs et suivre les conseils de dépistage du programme des survivants.
Lingala – draft: Mibali babikaki basengeli kosalela capote mpe kolanda toli ya komekama.
Kiswahili: Wanaume waliopona watumie kondomu na wafuate ushauri wa vipimo wa mpango wa waliopona.

English (source): Ebola disease is a rare but severe, often deadly illness caused by Ebola viruses (including Zaire, Sudan and Bundibugyo viruses).
Français: La maladie à virus Ebola est une maladie rare mais grave, souvent mortelle, causée par les virus Ebola (notamment Zaïre, Soudan et Bundibugyo).
Lingala – draft: Ebola ezali bokono ya makasi, mbala mingi ya kufa, oyo virus Ebola eyelaka (Zaïre, Soudan mpe Bundibugyo).
Kiswahili: Ugonjwa wa Ebola ni nadra lakini mkali, mara nyingi huua, na husababishwa na virusi vya Ebola (pamoja na Zaire, Sudan na Bundibugyo).

English (source): Symptoms appear 2 to 21 days after exposure, most often after 8 to 10 days.
Français: Les symptômes apparaissent 2 à 21 jours après le contact, le plus souvent après 8 à 10 jours.
Lingala – draft: Bilembo ebimaka mikolo 2 kino 21 nsima ya bokutani, mingi nsima ya mikolo 8 kino 10.
Kiswahili: Dalili huonekana siku 2 hadi 21 baada ya kuambukizwa, mara nyingi baada ya siku 8 hadi 10.

English (source): People are not contagious before symptoms start.
Français: Une personne n’est pas contagieuse avant le début des symptômes.
Lingala – draft: Moto apesaka bokono te liboso bilembo ebanda.
Kiswahili: Watu hawaambukizi kabla ya dalili kuanza.

English (source): Direct contact (through broken skin, eyes, nose or mouth) with blood or body fluids of a person who is sick with or has died from Ebola.
Français: Contact direct (par une plaie, les yeux, le nez ou la bouche) avec le sang ou les liquides du corps d'une personne malade ou morte d'Ebola.
Lingala – draft: Kosimba (na mpota, miso, zolo to monoko) makila to mai ya nzoto ya moto ya maladi to moto akufi na Ebola.
Kiswahili: Kugusa moja kwa moja (kupitia jeraha, macho, pua au mdomo) damu au majimaji ya mwili ya mtu mgonjwa au aliyekufa kwa Ebola.

English (source): Objects contaminated with those fluids, such as bedding, clothing and needles.
Français: Objets salis par ces liquides : draps, vêtements, aiguilles.
Lingala – draft: Biloko oyo mai yango ebebisi: bilamba ya mbeto, bilamba, batonga.
Kiswahili: Vitu vilivyochafuliwa na majimaji hayo, kama matandiko, nguo na sindano.

English (source): Infected animals such as fruit bats and primates.
Français: Animaux infectés comme les chauves-souris frugivores et les singes.
Lingala – draft: Banyama oyo bazali na bokono lokola bangembo mpe bakewa.
Kiswahili: Wanyama walioambukizwa kama popo wanaokula matunda na nyani.

English (source): Semen of a man who has recovered, for some time after recovery.
Français: Sperme d'un homme guéri, pendant un certain temps après la guérison.
Lingala – draft: Mai ya mobali oyo abikaki, mwa ntango nsima ya kobika.
Kiswahili: Shahawa za mwanamume aliyepona, kwa muda fulani baada ya kupona.

English (source): Fever, severe headache, muscle and joint pain, weakness and tiredness, sore throat.
Français: Fièvre, forts maux de tête, douleurs des muscles et des articulations, faiblesse et fatigue, mal de gorge.
Lingala – draft: Fièvre, motó kobeta makasi, mpasi na misuni mpe mikuwa, kolemba, mpasi na mongongo.
Kiswahili: Homa, maumivu makali ya kichwa, maumivu ya misuli na viungo, udhaifu na uchovu, maumivu ya koo.

Français: Ensuite : vomissements, diarrhée, douleurs au ventre.
Lingala – draft: Na nsima: kosanza, kosuba, mpasi na libumu.
Kiswahili: Baadaye: kutapika, kuhara, maumivu ya tumbo.

Lingala – draft: Mbala mosusu: makila ebimaka kozanga ntina.
Kiswahili: Wakati mwingine: kutoka damu au michubuko bila sababu.

English (source): Malaria, typhoid and other illnesses look similar at first — only a lab test can tell.
Français: Le paludisme, la typhoïde et d’autres maladies se ressemblent au début — seul un test de laboratoire peut le dire.
Lingala – draft: Malaria, typhoïde mpe bokono mosusu ekokanaka na ebandeli — kaka laboratoire nde ekoki koyebisa.
Kiswahili: Malaria, homa ya matumbo na magonjwa mengine hufanana mwanzoni — ni kipimo cha maabara pekee kinachoweza kusema.

English (source): MYTH: Ebola spreads through the air like flu. FACT: it spreads through contact with body fluids.
Français: FAUX : Ebola se transmet par l'air comme la grippe. VRAI : il se transmet par contact avec les liquides du corps.
Lingala – draft: LOKUTA: Ebola ekendaka na mopepe lokola grippe. SOLO: ekendaka soki osimbi mai ya nzoto.
Kiswahili: UONGO: Ebola huenea kwa hewa kama mafua. UKWELI: huenea kwa kugusa majimaji ya mwili.

English (source): MYTH: Salt water, onions, herbs or drinking bleach cure Ebola. FACT: they do not, and bleach is poisonous. Go to a treatment centre.
Français: FAUX : l'eau salée, les oignons, les plantes ou boire de l'eau de Javel guérissent Ebola. VRAI : non, et l'eau de Javel est un poison. Allez dans un centre de traitement.
Lingala – draft: LOKUTA: mai ya mungwa, litungulu, nkisi ya nkasa to komela Javel ebikisaka Ebola. SOLO: te, mpe Javel ezali ngenge. Kende na centre ya kosalisa.
Kiswahili: UONGO: maji ya chumvi, vitunguu, mitishamba au kunywa dawa ya kusafishia (bleach) huponya Ebola. UKWELI: haviponyi, na bleach ni sumu. Nenda kituo cha matibabu.

English (source): MYTH: Treatment centres are places where people go to die. FACT: early treatment saves lives, and many people recover.
Français: FAUX : les centres de traitement sont des lieux où l'on va mourir. VRAI : un traitement précoce sauve des vies et beaucoup de personnes guérissent.
Lingala – draft: LOKUTA: ba centre ya kosalisa ezali bisika ya kokufa. SOLO: kosalisama noki ebikisaka bomoi, mpe bato mingi babikaka.
Kiswahili: UONGO: vituo vya matibabu ni mahali watu huenda kufa. UKWELI: matibabu ya mapema huokoa maisha, na watu wengi hupona.

English (source): MYTH: Ebola is a curse or witchcraft. FACT: it is a virus, and simple steps can stop it.
Français: FAUX : Ebola est une malédiction ou de la sorcellerie. VRAI : c'est un virus, et des gestes simples peuvent l'arrêter.
Lingala – draft: LOKUTA: Ebola ezali kilakala to kindoki. SOLO: ezali virus, mpe makambo ya pete ekoki kopekisa yango.
Kiswahili: UONGO: Ebola ni laana au uchawi. UKWELI: ni virusi, na hatua rahisi zinaweza kuizuia.

English (source): MYTH: Survivors are dangerous. FACT: recovered people are not contagious through normal contact.
Français: FAUX : les survivants sont dangereux. VRAI : les personnes guéries ne sont pas contagieuses lors des contacts normaux.
Lingala – draft: LOKUTA: bato babikaki bazali likama. SOLO: bapesaka bokono te na bokutani ya mokolo na mokolo.
Kiswahili: UONGO: waliopona ni hatari. UKWELI: waliopona hawaambukizi kwa mawasiliano ya kawaida.

English (source): Videos open in YouTube or your browser and need internet. They may use mobile data.
Français: Les vidéos s'ouvrent dans YouTube ou votre navigateur et demandent Internet. Elles peuvent utiliser vos données mobiles.
Lingala – draft: Bavideo efungwamaka na YouTube to na navigateur mpe esengaka internet. Ekoki kosalela ba mégas na yo.
Kiswahili: Video hufunguka kwenye YouTube au kivinjari chako na zinahitaji intaneti. Zinaweza kutumia data ya simu.

English (source): Find more WHO videos on YouTube
Français: Plus de vidéos de l'OMS sur YouTube
Lingala – draft: Luka bavideo mosusu ya OMS na YouTube
Kiswahili: Tafuta video zaidi za WHO kwenye YouTube

English (source): Animated story for communities: how Ebola spreads and how to protect yourself and your family.
Français: Histoire animée pour les communautés : comment Ebola se transmet et comment vous protéger, vous et votre famille.
Lingala – draft: Lisolo ya bilili mpo na bato: ndenge Ebola ekendaka mpe ndenge ya komibatela yo na libota na yo.
Kiswahili: Hadithi ya katuni kwa jamii: jinsi Ebola inavyoenea na jinsi ya kujikinga wewe na familia yako.

English (source): Short WHO animation on Ebola transmission, symptoms and prevention.
Français: Courte animation de l'OMS sur la transmission, les symptômes et la prévention d'Ebola.
Lingala – draft: Video mokuse ya OMS na ntina ya ndenge Ebola ekendaka, bilembo mpe kobatela.
Kiswahili: Katuni fupi ya WHO kuhusu maambukizi, dalili na kinga ya Ebola.

English (source): What to do if someone shows symptoms of Ebola
Français: Que faire si quelqu'un présente des symptômes d'Ebola
Lingala – draft: Nini kosala soki moto azali na bilembo ya Ebola
Kiswahili: Nini cha kufanya mtu akiwa na dalili za Ebola

English (source): Simple animation available in many African languages — choose yours on the page.
Français: Animation simple disponible dans de nombreuses langues africaines — choisissez la vôtre sur la page.
Lingala – draft: Video ya pete na minoko mingi ya Afrika — pona oyo ya yo na lokasa.
Kiswahili: Katuni rahisi inayopatikana katika lugha nyingi za Kiafrika — chagua yako kwenye ukurasa.

Français: La riposte de l'OMS contre Ebola
Kiswahili: Mwitikio wa WHO dhidi ya Ebola

English (source): How health teams respond to an Ebola outbreak.
Français: Comment les équipes de santé répondent à une épidémie d’Ebola.
Lingala – draft: Ndenge bato ya santé babundaka na Ebola.
Kiswahili: Jinsi timu za afya zinavyokabiliana na mlipuko wa Ebola.

Français: Au cœur de la riposte Ebola
Lingala – draft: Na kati ya etumba na Ebola

English (source): Health workers and communities working together in the current response.
Français: Agents de santé et communautés travaillent ensemble dans la riposte actuelle.
Lingala – draft: Basali ya santé mpe bato ya mboka bazali kosala elongo sikoyo.
Kiswahili: Wahudumu wa afya na jamii wakifanya kazi pamoja katika mwitikio wa sasa.

English (source): Official facts, outbreak news and guidance from the World Health Organization.
Français: Informations officielles, actualités et recommandations de l'Organisation mondiale de la Santé.
Lingala – draft: Bansango ya solo mpe toli ya Ebongiseli ya Mokili mobimba ya Santé (OMS).
Kiswahili: Taarifa rasmi, habari za milipuko na miongozo kutoka Shirika la Afya Duniani.

English (source): News and videos about outbreaks in Africa.
Français: Actualités et vidéos sur les épidémies en Afrique.
Lingala – draft: Bansango mpe bavideo na ntina ya Ebola na Afrika.
Kiswahili: Habari na video kuhusu milipuko barani Afrika.

English (source): Symptoms, prevention, travel advice and current outbreak information.
Français: Symptômes, prévention, conseils aux voyageurs et informations sur l’épidémie actuelle.
Lingala – draft: Bilembo, kobatela, toli mpo na mobembo mpe bansango ya sikoyo.
Kiswahili: Dalili, kinga, ushauri wa safari na taarifa za mlipuko wa sasa.

English (source): Advice for people who were recently in an outbreak area.
Français: Conseils pour les personnes qui ont récemment séjourné dans une zone touchée.
Lingala – draft: Toli mpo na bato bautaki na esika ya Ebola.
Kiswahili: Ushauri kwa watu waliokuwa hivi karibuni katika eneo lenye mlipuko.

English (source): Free videos for communities and health workers, in several languages.
Français: Vidéos gratuites pour les communautés et les agents de santé, en plusieurs langues.
Lingala – draft: Bavideo ya ofele mpo na bato mpe basali ya santé, na minoko mingi.
Kiswahili: Video za bure kwa jamii na wahudumu wa afya, katika lugha kadhaa.

English (source): Always follow the instructions of your Ministry of Health and local health workers.
Français: Suivez toujours les instructions de votre ministère de la Santé et des agents de santé locaux.
Lingala – draft: Landa ntango nyonso toli ya Ministère ya Santé mpe ya basali ya santé ya esika na yo.
Kikongo – draft: Landa ntangu yonso malongi ya Ministère ya Santé mpi ya bantu ya santé ya kisika na nge.
Tshiluba – draft: Londa misangu yonso mibelu ya Ministère wa Santé ne ya bena mudimu wa santé ba muaba webe.
Kiswahili: Fuata daima maelekezo ya Wizara yako ya Afya na wahudumu wa afya wa eneo lako.

Français: Zones touchées et centres de traitement
Lingala – draft: Bisika Ebola ekomi mpe ba centre ya kosalisa
Kikongo – draft: Bisika Ebola me kuma mpi ba centre ya kubelusa
Tshiluba – draft: Miaba idi Ebola ne ba centre ba kuondapa
Kiswahili: Maeneo yaliyoathirika na vituo vya matibabu
nakala ya ndani ya programu (bila mtandao)

English (source): Circles show provinces or countries with cases, not exact borders.
Français: Les cercles montrent les provinces ou pays touchés, pas les limites exactes.
Lingala – draft: Ba cercle elakisi ba province to mikili ezali na Ebola, ndelo ya solo te.
Kiswahili: Duara zinaonyesha mikoa au nchi zenye wagonjwa, si mipaka kamili.

English (source): The map needs internet. Use the List tab when offline.
Français: La carte a besoin d'Internet. Hors ligne, utilisez l'onglet Liste.
Lingala – draft: Karte esengaka internet. Soki internet ezali te, salela Liste.
Kiswahili: Ramani inahitaji intaneti. Bila mtandao, tumia Orodha.

English (source): If you or someone near you may have Ebola, call the health hotline FIRST. Health workers will tell you where to go and may send transport. Do not take public transport.
Français: Si vous ou une personne proche avez peut-être Ebola, appelez D'ABORD la ligne d'urgence sanitaire. Les agents de santé vous diront où aller et peuvent envoyer un véhicule. Ne prenez pas les transports en commun.
Lingala – draft: Soki yo to moto pembeni na yo akoki kozala na Ebola, benga LIBOSO numero ya mbangu ya santé. Basali ya santé bakoyebisa yo esika ya kokende mpe bakoki kotinda motuka. Kotambola na motuka ya bato nyonso te.
Kikongo – draft: Kana nge to muntu pene-pene na nge lenda vanda ti Ebola, binga NTETE numero ya nswalu ya santé. Bantu ya santé ta zabisa nge kisika ya kukwenda mpi lenda tinda kamio. Kutambula ve na kamio ya bantu yonso.
Tshiluba – draft: Wewe anyi muntu udi pabuipi nebe biikala mua kuikala ne Ebola, bikila KUMPALA numero wa lukasa wa santé. Bena mudimu wa santé nebakuambile muaba wa kuya ne badi mua kutuma mashinyi. Kuendi mu mashinyi a bantu bonso to.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa wewe au mtu aliye karibu nawe huenda ana Ebola, piga KWANZA namba ya dharura ya afya. Wahudumu wa afya watakuambia uende wapi na wanaweza kutuma usafiri. Usitumie usafiri wa umma.

Kikongo – draft: Nge me binga numero ya nswalu?
Kiswahili: Umepiga simu kwa namba ya dharura?

English (source): Go to a treatment centre only after calling, or if health workers told you to. Do not take public transport, and keep away from other people on the way.
Français: N'allez dans un centre de traitement qu'après avoir appelé, ou si les agents de santé vous l'ont demandé. Ne prenez pas les transports en commun et restez loin des autres personnes en chemin.
Lingala – draft: Kende na centre ya kosalisa kaka nsima ya kobenga, to soki basali ya santé bayebisi yo. Kotambola na motuka ya bato nyonso te, mpe kabwana na bato na nzela.
Kikongo – draft: Kwenda na centre ya kubelusa kaka na nima ya kubinga, to kana bantu ya santé me zabisa nge. Kutambula ve na kamio ya bantu yonso, mpi vanda ntama ti bantu na nzila.
Tshiluba – draft: Ya ku centre wa kuondapa anu panyima pa kubikila, anyi bena mudimu wa santé biobakuambila. Kuendi mu mashinyi a bantu bonso to, ne ikala kule ne bantu mu njila.
Kiswahili: Nenda kituo cha matibabu baada ya kupiga simu tu, au ikiwa wahudumu wa afya wamekuambia. Usitumie usafiri wa umma, na kaa mbali na watu njiani.

English (source): I have called – show the way
Kikongo – draft: Mono me binga – songa mono nzila

English (source): Last confirmed in official reports: {d}. Centres can move or close – check with the hotline.
Français: Dernière confirmation dans les rapports officiels : {d}. Les centres peuvent changer ou fermer – vérifiez auprès de la ligne d’urgence.
Lingala – draft: Endimisami mbala ya suka na ba rapport ya leta: {d}. Ba centre ekoki kobongwana to kokangama – tuna na numero ya mbangu.
Kiswahili: Ilithibitishwa mara ya mwisho katika ripoti rasmi: {d}. Vituo vinaweza kuhama au kufungwa – uliza kwa namba ya dharura.

Lingala – draft: Tuna motuna moko na ntina ya Ebola…

English (source): Could not open the camera or gallery.
Français: Impossible d’ouvrir l’appareil photo ou la galerie.
Lingala – draft: Tokoki te kofungola kamera to bafoto.

English (source): Optional. Save your name and photo. Everything else works without an account.
Français: Facultatif. Gardez votre prénom et votre photo. Tout le reste fonctionne sans compte.
Lingala – draft: Ezali na makasi te. Bomba kombo mpe foto na yo. Makambo mosusu nyonso esalaka kozanga kont.
Kiswahili: Si lazima. Hifadhi jina na picha yako. Kila kitu kingine kinafanya kazi bila akaunti.

English (source): Log in to your Ebola Guard account.
Français: Connectez-vous à votre compte Ebola Guard.
Lingala – draft: Kota na kont na yo ya Ebola Guard.
Kiswahili: Ingia kwenye akaunti yako ya Ebola Guard.

English (source): Online accounts are not switched on yet. Your profile will be saved on this phone only.
Français: Les comptes en ligne ne sont pas encore activés. Votre profil sera enregistré sur ce téléphone uniquement.
Lingala – draft: Bakont na internet ebandi naino te. Profil na yo ekobombama kaka na telefone oyo.
Kiswahili: Akaunti za mtandaoni bado hazijawashwa. Wasifu wako utahifadhiwa kwenye simu hii tu.

English (source): I agree to the privacy policy.
Please agree to the privacy policy first.
Français: Veuillez d’abord accepter la politique de confidentialité.
Lingala – draft: Svp, ndima liboso mibeko ya kobomba makambo.
Kiswahili: Tafadhali kubali sera ya faragha kwanza.

English (source): Already have an account? Log in

Français: Pas encore de compte ? Créez-en un
Lingala – draft: Ozali na kont te? Sala moko

English (source): If this e-mail has an account, we sent a link to reset the password.
Français: Si cet e-mail a un compte, nous avons envoyé un lien pour changer le mot de passe.
Lingala – draft: Soki e-mail oyo ezali na kont, totindi lien mpo na kobongola mot de passe.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa barua pepe hii ina akaunti, tumetuma kiungo cha kubadilisha nenosiri.

English (source): Your check answers stay on your phone. They are never added to your account.
Français: Vos réponses au test restent sur votre téléphone. Elles ne sont jamais ajoutées à votre compte.
Lingala – draft: Biyano na yo ya komeka etikalaka na telefone na yo. Ekotiama soki moke te na kont na yo.
Kiswahili: Majibu ya kipimo chako hubaki kwenye simu yako. Hayaongezwi kamwe kwenye akaunti yako.

English (source): We sent a link to {e}. Open it to confirm your account, then log in here.
Français: Nous avons envoyé un lien à {e}. Ouvrez-le pour confirmer votre compte, puis connectez-vous ici.
Lingala – draft: Totindi lien na {e}. Fungola yango mpo na kondimisa kont na yo, sima kota awa.
Kiswahili: Tumetuma kiungo kwa {e}. Kifungue kuthibitisha akaunti yako, kisha uingie hapa.

English (source): This removes your name, e-mail and photo for good. You can still use the app without an account.
Français: Cela efface définitivement votre prénom, votre e-mail et votre photo. Vous pourrez toujours utiliser l’application sans compte.
Lingala – draft: Yango ekolongola kombo, e-mail mpe foto na yo mpo na libela. Okoki kaka kosalela application kozanga kont.
Kiswahili: Hii itafuta jina, barua pepe na picha yako kabisa. Bado unaweza kutumia programu bila akaunti.

English (source): No connection. Check your internet and try again.
Français: Pas de connexion. Vérifiez internet et réessayez.
Lingala – draft: Internet ezali te. Tala internet na yo mpe meka lisusu.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mtandao. Angalia intaneti yako ujaribu tena.

Français: E-mail ou mot de passe incorrect.
Lingala – draft: E-mail to mot de passe ezali malamu te.
Kiswahili: Barua pepe au nenosiri si sahihi.

English (source): An account with this e-mail already exists. Log in instead.
Français: Un compte existe déjà avec cet e-mail. Connectez-vous plutôt.
Lingala – draft: Kont ezali kala na e-mail oyo. Kota na esika ya kosala mosusu.
Kiswahili: Akaunti yenye barua pepe hii ipo tayari. Ingia badala yake.

English (source): This password is too weak. Use a longer one.
Français: Mot de passe trop faible. Utilisez-en un plus long.
Lingala – draft: Mot de passe oyo ezali makasi te. Salela oyo ya molai.
Kiswahili: Nenosiri hili ni dhaifu. Tumia refu zaidi.

English (source): Please confirm your e-mail first (check your inbox).
Français: Confirmez d’abord votre e-mail (regardez votre boîte de réception).
Lingala – draft: Svp, ndimisa liboso e-mail na yo (tala bamesaje na yo).
Kiswahili: Tafadhali thibitisha barua pepe yako kwanza (angalia kisanduku).

English (source): Too many tries. Please wait a few minutes.
Kiswahili: Majaribio mengi mno. Subiri dakika chache.

English (source): Something went wrong. Please try again.
Lingala – draft: Likambo moko esalemi malamu te. Meka lisusu.

Kikongo – draft: Kisika nsangu me katuka (mikanda ya leta)
Tshiluba – draft: Muaba udi malu afumina (mikanda ya mbulamatadi)
